mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that suppresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in unemployment rate signals aggressive central bank easing amid labor market deterioration, which precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing during labor market weakness
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE increase fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), labor market weakness signals reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening residential investment and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, a sustained increase in retail sales above its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 12-month moving average during post-pandemic recovery, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market dynamics that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
